limits.scope: Three reused FFHQ images x SR4/Gaussian; paired BASE/SHRINK, one seed; not an author benchmark mean.
limits.module: Unchanged A71 noise_signal_shrink.select; gamma>=0 continuous, no clipping2, beta, search, or policy fallback.
limits.coordinates: Model[-1,1] sigma=.05. Each host owns its original H; NEW y shared within its two arms. Cross-host observations are not identical.
limits.response: MPGD exact linear clean-space Hq. DMPS/PGDM same-time identity clean-response proxy Hq/sqrt(alpha_t); not a measured next-denoiser response.
limits.baseline: Pinned author loop/conditioning/operator AST; only one explicit correction expression can be instrumented; forced gamma1 and unmodified native loop must match.
limits.MPGD: Original x0ddim100,eta.5; scale5 for BOTH tasks from paper appendixD.1. Released SR100 script4 / CLI default10 differ and are not quality-selected. No autoencoder.
limits.DMPS: Original DDPM1000 learned_range,scale1.75. Original bicubicSR and configuredGaussian61/intensity3 actually constructs31-tap separable native SVD kernel.
limits.PIGDM: Author RED-diff PGDM, released default50 uniform t980..0,eta0,awdTrue,weight1; SR native average-pooling SVD, Gaussian native5-tap sigma25. Raw clean predictor, native pseudo-inverse initialization, native final xs. No noise-covariance modification.
limits.cost: No extra UNet/input VJP from module; TWO extra H evaluations/candidate step. MPGD original clean/operator gradients are separate from UNet VJP.
limits.timing: Full loop includes given-y load, native operator construction/SVD, RNG/init/sampling/outputCPU sync and progress bookkeeping. Excludes model load/probe, creation of shared y, metrics and artifact writes; record each separately.
limits.boundaries: Original positive correction amplitude can be canceled by projection. Do not inherit manifold/posterior guarantees or infer state necessity from two-arm gain.
limits.decision: Per host/task: mean PSNR>=+.1dB,>=2/3 PSNR wins,SSIM nondecrease,LPIPS nonincrease; require init/finalRNG/grid pairing. Mixed quality reported separately. No rescue tuning.
